summary: Wah Fu Education Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, furnishing a press release and amended BVI memorandum and articles announcing a completed corporate name change to Wah Fu Education Technology Group Limited, effective October 2, 2026, after board authorization. The Nasdaq ticker WAFU remains unchanged and shareholder rights are unaffected; no shares are exchanged and holders need take no action. The rebranding reflects a strategic upgrade toward a technology-driven education ecosystem spanning digital learning platforms and smart education solutions, not a special situation. Watch for subsequent disclosure on technology-segment operations and any capital or structural actions.
